name: Mdppp
summary: 3',4'-Methylenedioxy-α-pyrrolidinopropiophenone (MDPPP) is a stimulant designer drug. It was sold in Germany in the late 1990s and early 2000s as an ingredient in imitation ecstasy (MDMA) pills. It shares a similar chemical structure with α-PPP and MDPV, and has been shown to have reinforcing effects in rats.

pharmacology.text: It shares a similar chemical structure with α-PPP and MDPV, and has been shown to have reinforcing effects in rats.

uses.text: 3',4'-Methylenedioxy-α-pyrrolidinopropiophenone (MDPPP) is a stimulant designer drug. It was sold in Germany in the late 1990s and early 2000s as an ingredient in imitation ecstasy (MDMA) pills.
uses.routes: By mouth, insufflation, vaporization, IV, rectal, sublingual

summaryZh: MDPPP是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C14H17NO3，屬於吡咯烷基卡西酮衍生物，為新型毒品，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。
summaryZhHans: MDPPP是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式为C14H17NO3，属于吡咯烷基卡西酮衍生物，为新型毒品，2015年列入《非药用类麻醉药品和精神药品名录》。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Pyrrolidine cathinones like MDPV can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, overheating, paranoia, psychosis and strong urges to redose, and have been linked to deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。MDPV 之類的吡咯烷卡西酮可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、體溫過高、偏執、精神病與強烈的追加使用衝動，也曾與死亡案例有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。MDPV 之类的吡咯烷卡西酮可能引起心跳过快、高血压、体温过高、偏执、精神病与强烈的追加使用冲动，也曾与死亡案例有关。

fact.en: MDPPP turned up in Germany around the turn of the millennium as a hidden ingredient in fake ecstasy pills. It is the shorter-chain cousin of MDPV.
fact.zh: MDPPP 在千禧年前後於德國出現，被暗中摻入假的搖頭丸中。它是 MDPV 側鏈較短的表親。
fact.zhHans: MDPPP 在千禧年前后于德国出现，被暗中掺入假的摇头丸中。它是 MDPV 侧链较短的表亲。
